incidents.name: MINER transfer-fee pair skim
incidents.notes: MINER's _transfer burns part of the MINER/WBNB pair's balance on each trade, so the attacker looped small buys with pair.skim() to keep pushing the price up before selling out.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x2ba9d4a8c41c60b71ff7df2c3f54b008644b954e created 2024-02-12T11:23:40Z by 0x06f8fc2ceaebb832b338cc8b34191a0e885494a7, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x031958a8137745350549fd95055398dd536a07c7; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 3.5 WBNB x $323.88/BNB at the incident timestamp 1707862458 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,134.
